description: Use when you run sanctions monitoring and need what changed since your last run: entries added, removed and amended on OFAC SDN, UK, EU, Canada and US CSL since a date, one format, with list. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /sanctions/changes, $0.02 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

lists.description: Optional comma list of ofac, uk, eu, ca, csl; default all

since.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD: changes in list versions dated on or after it (log keeps 90 days)

name: sanctions_changes
title: Sanctions changes
